component.name: AIFusion
component.summary: Desktop client for the AIFusion platform (Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI)

description.p: AIFusion is a cross-platform desktop client that points Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI (plus OpenAI-compatible clients) at the AIFusion platform.

ul.li: Ships a single built-in AIFusion provider per client
One-click switch and sync to client live configurations
